description: This file defines the HtmlMenuItemPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of HtmlMenuItemPart objects within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles HTML sanitization, URL validation, and rendering of menu items.

classes.name: HtmlMenuItemPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class responsible for rendering, editing, and updating HtmlMenuItemPart objects in OrchardCore, including URL validation and HTML sanitization.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders the display view of the HtmlMenuItemPart, applying HTML sanitization if enabled.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the view model for editing the HtmlMenuItemPart.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the HtmlMenuItemPart, including URL validation and sanitization.
